title: Worms screensaver
tagline: Bright worms wandering the screen, forever.
teaser: Colourful worms roam, turn and tangle across the glass. Nothing to win and everything to watch.

manPage.synopsis: worms — watch worms wander; change how many and how fast.
manPage.description: Eric P. Scott’s worms animated little worms crawling around a display terminal. It returns as a smooth, colourful screensaver.

howToPlay: Start the worms and let them roam.
Change how many worms there are and how fast they go.
Sit back: there is nothing to win.
